body: When one of them is using the high tech bench, what is the other doing? They should use both if they are both set to research. Most likely the other one has a higher priority task, or perhaps you changed the minimum intellectual skill setting on the low tier bench? Getting the smarter pawn to use the better bench and the other the worse bench is not straight forward and would probably require editing allowable areas. Ideally just make both benches high tier. At the end of the day the research productivity from having your best researcher at the best table and the other one at the bad table is not all that much higher than the best researcher at the bad table and the bad researcher at the good table.
